long_biography.plain_text:
Peter K. Tully led his family's heavy-construction firm during the World Trade Center recovery after the September 11 attacks, when it became one of the cleanup's early responders. The firm had already worked on airports, bridges, tunnels and major public works across New York.

Trained in law and admitted to New York's bar, Tully applied a contractor's focus to operations and industry leadership. He directed major dam, reservoir, highway and transit work, while acquisitions added national civil and marine-construction capabilities to the group. His tenure has also included leadership roles in contractor associations and the New York Building Congress.
